title: Natural module/Ext comparisons intertwining the scalar-extension unit
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings in the scheme universe, with an R-algebra structure on B. Let h:Y -> Spec R be any scheme morphism and p a nonnegative integer [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. On Y and Y_B = Y times Spec B over Spec R there exist families E_M and E prime_L of additive equivalences from module derived sections to the ordinary Ext model H [pqf-def-cohomology], natural for every module morphism on the respective scheme. For every module N on Y and every module cohomology class x, E prime at N_B of the module cohomology map of the pullback unit applied to x equals H.baseChangeLinear(h,N,p)(E_N(x)) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. There are no quasi-coherence, qcqs or flatness assumptions. This concerns only the two cohomology models of the same unit map; it neither constructs a Leray equivalence nor mentions an ambient higher direct image.

proof.text: Choose the natural comparison families with identity-edge compatibility from the edge theorem.
Apply the proved generic coefficient transport to the base-change unit, using source naturality of E and the edge compatibility. Its Ext formula equals H.baseChangeLinear by definition.

theorem exists_moduleCohomology_ext_pullback_comparison
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : ∀ M : Y.Modules,
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj M) ≃+ H M p,
      ∃ E' : ∀ M : (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).Modules,
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).toRingedSpace p).obj M) ≃+ H M p,
        (∀ (M M' : Y.Modules) (φ : M ⟶ M')
          (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj M),
          E M' (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) =
            H.map φ p (E M x)) ∧
        (∀ (M M' : (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).Modules) (φ : M ⟶ M')
          (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
            (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).toRingedSpace p).obj M),
          E' M' (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
            (baseChangedScheme (S := B) h).toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) =
            H.map φ p (E' M x)) ∧
        (∀ (N : Y.Modules)
          (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj N),
          E' (baseChangedModule (S := B) h N)
            (moduleCohomologyFMap (baseChangeFst (S := B) h)
              (baseChangeUnit (S := B) h N) p x) =
            H.baseChangeLinear (S := B) h N p (E N x))
